# Weighted GPA calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/gpa-calculator/

Calculate a weighted grade-point average from a list of grade points and credits. Choose the maximum point scale to match your institution.

## How to use it

1. Choose a study tool and review its input labels.
2. Enter your scores, course details, passage or available study time.
3. Run the tool and review the result and its assumptions.

## Example

Combine a 3-point course worth three credits with a 4-point course worth two credits.

## Limits and checks

Enter grade points already assigned by your institution. This does not infer a country’s letter-grade or percentage conversion rules.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
